decision.authority: owner d1b9f3c0 / correction7d8d831e; worker w5 first homepage review
decision.rationale: The official UBC Arts eNunciate homepage offers public phonetics and pronunciation learning materials for linguistics and language students, without an Okanagan-exclusive mandate. Observed research and media sections override the academic learning purpose; copyright guidance is support. No separate opportunities or personal-story section is evidenced.
evidence: https://enunciate.arts.ubc.ca/ | f1667066e99532d47fa5ff0ee1208c34fbf1475fdd392c0357c47be3808239be | The University of British Columbia; eNunciate!; Faculty of Arts link to www.arts.ubc.ca; A Visual Language Learning Tool.

https://enunciate.arts.ubc.ca/ | f1667066e99532d47fa5ff0ee1208c34fbf1475fdd392c0357c47be3808239be | Our INTERACTIVE IPA CHART provides articulatory information including ULTRASOUND-enhanced videos and high-quality animations about the sounds of the world's languages. Watch introductory videos to learn about phonetics and the use of ultrasound in speech research.

https://enunciate.arts.ubc.ca/ | f1667066e99532d47fa5ff0ee1208c34fbf1475fdd392c0357c47be3808239be | Self-Directed Modules: For students in Linguistics or in Language Programmes, watch PRONUNCIATION TUTORIAL videos about challenging sounds in JAPANESE and other languages.

https://enunciate.arts.ubc.ca/ | f1667066e99532d47fa5ff0ee1208c34fbf1475fdd392c0357c47be3808239be | Homepage sections: Learning Tools; Introductory Videos; Pronunciation Station; Self-Directed Modules; Research and Case Studies; Research by the eNunciate Team; Other Research; Case Studies; Media; Copyright.

rules.rationale: The homepage explicitly separates team research, other research and case studies from language-learning tools.
The homepage identifies a separate Media section for coverage of the project.
The Copyright section provides guidance for using the learning resources.
Learning Tools, Self-Directed Modules and Japanese Pronunciation support phonetics and language study.

fallback.rationale: eNunciate is a visual language-learning resource providing phonetic instruction and pronunciation tutorials.
